announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim Results are released. Shareholders should watch for details linking to the Teep Gold Project and Black Star developments announced in September and October.

announcements.headline: Teep Assays Return up to 104.99 g/t gold
announcements.insight: Teep Assays Return up to 104.99 g/t gold confirms the expansion of the Teep Gold Project announced in September.

announcements.headline: Launch of New Company Website
announcements.insight: London BTC Company Limited has launched a new website. This is likely administrative housekeeping with minimal immediate financial impact for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Potential of Antinomy & Copper at Black Star
announcements.insight: BTC explores antimony and copper potential at Black Star, following earlier Nevada gold and silver expansion updates.

announcements.headline: Teep Gold Project in Nevada now Extends to 3.5km
announcements.insight: BTC confirms its Nevada project extends to 3.5km, following earlier gold discovery and assay results from July and August.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow recent Nevada exploration updates. This confirms routine governance proceedings for the group.

announcements.headline: Gold, Silver, Critical Minerals Expansion Underway
announcements.insight: BTC expands its Nevada portfolio by adding silver and critical minerals to existing gold projects. Shareholders should monitor assay results for these new targets.

announcements.headline: Antimony Targeted for Nevada Exploration
announcements.insight: BTC shifts focus from gold to antimony exploration in Nevada. This follows recent high-grade gold assay results and project staking.

announcements.headline: Gold Assays Return up to 143.1 g/t in Nevada USA
announcements.insight: BTC reports gold assays up to 143.1 g/t in Nevada USA, following earlier staking and discovery announcements in June and July 2026.

announcements.headline: Gold Discovery In Nevada, USA
announcements.insight: BTC reports assay results of 37 g/t gold following earlier staking in June. This confirms exploration activity at the Nevada project.

announcements.headline: 37 g/t Gold and 1,332 g/t Silver in Nevada
announcements.insight: BTC reports assay results of 37 g/t Gold and 1,332 g/t Silver in Nevada. This follows earlier staking of the Huntington-Whitman Gold Project in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Second Gold Project Staked
announcements.insight: London BTC Company Limited has staked a second gold project, following the Huntington-Whitman Gold Project staking in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Staking of the Huntington-Whitman Gold Project
announcements.insight: London BTC Company Limited has announced the staking of the Huntington-Whitman Gold Project. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding this asset.
